This week we will delve into more societal issues around the gathering and analysis of health data, with our guest speaker, Dr. [Max Perry](https://www.sps.ed.ac.uk/staff/max-edward-perry). Additionally, we will have Dr. Suzanne Goopy, brining to the table some ethical issues and concerns in health and biomedical contexts.

## Structure of this week

1.  Thursday the 19th of November: Guest lecture, followed by a Q&A
2.  Friday the 20th of November: Guest lecture, followed by a Q&A
